name: HiGS (history-guided sampling)
plain: Adds a high-pass filtered push away from a running average of past guided outputs, inside a time window.
math:
g_k=u+wΔ; h_k=EMA of past g
D=g_k−h_k; D=D⊥+ηD∥; soft DCT high-pass H
x̂=g_k+w_H(t)·H(D), w_H=w_h√((t−t_min)/(t_max−t_min))
